entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Authentication request message used in 5G NAS authentication procedure.

entities.name: Extended protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for NAS messages.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Indicates the security protection applied to the NAS message.

entities.name: Spare half octet
entities.description: Reserved bits for alignment in NAS message header.

entities.name: Authentication request message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as AUTHENTICATION REQUEST.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: NAS key set identifier indicating the security context to be used.

entities.name: ABBA
entities.description: Anti-bidding down between architectures parameter for security negotiation.

entities.name: Authentication parameter RAND (5G authentication challenge)
entities.description: Random challenge value used in 5G authentication.

entities.name: Authentication parameter AUTN (5G authentication challenge)
entities.description: Authentication token used in 5G authentication challenge.

entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: Extensible Authentication Protocol message for authentication.

relations.description: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains the Extended protocol discriminator IE.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains the Security header type IE.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains the Spare half octet IE.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains the Authentication request message identity IE.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains the ngKSI IE.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains the ABBA IE.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message optionally contains the Authentication parameter RAND IE.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message optionally contains the Authentication parameter AUTN IE.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message optionally contains the EAP message IE.
